verdict.rationale: Figma Make's own help docs state that you can assign a custom domain you own to your app, which directly delivers the core of the story. The evidence is a single sentence, with no setup detail or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documented DNS/SSL setup steps, plan or tier requirements, explicit tie-in to the publish flow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect a custom domain to my published app

citations.quote: You can also assign a custom domain that you own.
